message: We've all been there—suddenly the lights go out, and you realize you have no idea where the candles are, or worse, the ice cream is melting! 😂 Preparing for a blackout doesn't have to be a comedy of errors. I found a great resource that walks you through simple steps to get ready for when the power goes out. Remember, a little prep can go a long way in keeping the mood light and cozy. What’s your go-to tip for staying calm during a blackout?
